title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Mantle adds Paxos’ USDG stablecoin, joins Global Dollar Network
summary: Mantle has added Paxos-issued USDG as a natively minted stablecoin while joining the network’s reward-sharing structure.

title: Michigan authorities continue pursuit to block Kalshi as Supreme Court fight looms
summary: Kalshi previously said it had been placed in an “impossible position” after federal authorities directed the company to ignore a Michigan restraining order issued in June.

title: Bitcoin reclaims $80K as DXY falls amid continuing suspected yen intervention
summary: Bitcoin rallied 5% to reclaim $80,000 as the US dollar weakened amid a suspected Bank of Japan currency intervention, though analysts remain split on the impact.

title: Bybit Pay integrates with Mesh to expand crypto payments
summary: The integration lets Bybit users spend digital assets directly from their exchange balances across Mesh-powered platforms.

title: BitMEX co-founder contributed 75% of Reform UK’s donations in Q2 2026
summary: The UK political party and its leader, Nigel Farage, have accepted contributions from figures tied to the crypto industry, raising questions about potential influence on policies.

title: Kraken parent Payward partners with SoFi on stablecoin, 24/7 settlement
summary: The deal will bring SoFiUSD to Kraken, connect Payward to SoFi’s 24/7 dollar settlement network and give SoFi access to digital asset liquidity through Kraken Prime.

title: Recovery specialists crack $1B crypto wallet... but find just $10
summary: Crypto recovery specialists reveal how lost wallets, passwords and seed phrases can sometimes be recovered — but that’s of no help if the money was never there in the first place.

title: VARA, Securitize sign MoU for tokenization innovation in Dubai
summary: VARA and Securitize signed an MoU to foster more tokenization innovation in Dubai and explore how tokenized financial innovation should be regulated in the region.

title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face for $12.9B in push into AI software
summary: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, gaining a platform used by more than 18 million developers to share and deploy AI models.
